Composite Squadron, Weak

A squadron of the most basic variants of Ugly Starfighters. All flying scrap metal that are armed coffins for pilots with the only benefit being low cost allowing easy replacement. Lightly armed and lower performance of the sum of their parts and lacking any heavy weapons means they can only serve as cheap escort fighters or meat shields for proper starfighters.

12 Models per squadron.

Land Bombing Run Unit Bombing Run Ordnance: High Explosive Bombs, effective against large concentractions of units. Bombing Run Type: Carpet Bombing

Dogfighter, Shoddy Construction

The new standard Headhunter model is equipped with Concussion Missiles, making the Z-95 more effective than it should be at supporting friendly fighters against hostile starfighters, severely debuffing their firepower thereby allowing friendly craft to more cost-effectively deal with them. On its own, the standard Headhunter is not very good at anything but be annoying thanks to its debuff.

Armor: Medium 2x Medium Laser, 1x Concussion Missile Agility: 1.8 Max Speed: 3.5 SP: 30(3/s) HP: 32 8 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. Concussion missile: crippling debuff, long-Ranged, no shield penetration. 20 ||| 20 | 15 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 500m range. Applies -85% Firerate debuff to Fighter/Bomber for 12s.

Small Target, Dogfighter, Anti-Light, Astromech, Interceptor Shielding

The nimble Alpha-3 Nimbus or V-wing for short offers excellent durability for a light interceptor. Equipped with rapidly recharging Interceptor shields and an astromech for onboard repairs the fast and agile V-wing excels at dogfighting light craft such as the numerous CIS' unshielded lightly armored droids it was designed to counter. Armed with low-range light repeating Lasers it lacks the firepower to take on more heavily armored craft however. While old, the V-wing is hardly obsolete when used appropriately and has proven effective against newer light fighter models such as the TIE Fighter, adding to its popularity by pirates and para-military organizations alike. Best used to dogfight lightly armored foes lacking the damage output to pierce the V-wings rapidly recharging shields.

Armor: Light 2x Light Laser Agility: 2.025 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 18(4.5/s) HP: 28(1/s) 8 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range.

Small Target, Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Interceptor Shielding, Powerful Engines

Focussing on speed and agility over all other attributes, the elegant and aerodynamic N1 Starfighter, or Naboo Starfighter is an expensive light interceptor used exclusively by the people of Naboo. The N1 is extremely small, thin, and very difficult to hit, capable of dodging even missiles while dogfighting and equipped with rapidly-recharging Interceptor Shielding quickly absorbing any light impacts and an astromech for self-repair. While the Naboo Starfighter is a high performance interceptor, it is only armed with twin repeating Light Lasers and a Homing Torpedo launcher, and its luck can quickly turn against craft with medium to heavy armor, or dedicated interceptors capable of breaching its light shields and armor. Best used to dogfight against lightly armored craft.

Armor: Light 2x Light Repeating Laser, 1x Homing Torpedo Agility: 2.0 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 14(4.5/s) HP: 21(1/s) 8 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Homing Proton torpedo: tracks target, ignores shields, good vs armor. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability.

A pair of YT Light Freighters used across the galaxy by traders, smugglers, and bounty hunters for being very modable much like the ancient hologame Star Wars: Empire at War - Forces of Corruption. These vanilla models straight from CEC lack the vast modifications modders would place on them like the famed Millennium Falcon and Outrider but retain a high durability, reasonable agility for their sizem and 360 degree of weapon coverage.

This is the only Hammerhead you're ever going to get so stop asking us! The Hammerhead-class Cruiser was the staple of the Old Republic starfleet for over 3000 years. It's forward-facing long range main turbolaser cannons in combination with its small hangar made for a versatile light frigate with great forward range. But, the Hammerhead is vulnerable from any direction but its front aside from two anti-starfighter laser batteries, and after its hugely succesful lifespan the Hammerhead was eventually phased out in favour of ships without this weakness. A well-rounded light frigate ideal for long range fire-support.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 3000; Hit points: 3000; 1 Ancient Sith Fighter (0)

Vindicator-class Heavy Cruiser. A frontline frigate developed by Seinar Fleet Systems, the Vindicator is a strong wolfpack ship that specializes against corvettes and smaller frigates with its accurate medium ion cannons and dual turbolasers. In high numbers it can present a serious threat against larger targets. While durable and powerful for its size, it lacks anti-starfighter defence, and so needs protection from hostile bombers.

Max speed: 3.0; Shield points: 6000; Hit points: 7500; 1 TIE Bizarro (1)

Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser. An ancient battleship of the Republic designed over three-thousand years ago when large warships ruled the stars before advancement in weapon tech rendered them obsolete. Cheap and easy to acquire in the modern age, these vessels are ideally suited for anti-piracy duty and a powerful missile platform despite the relatively light laser armament for such a massive warship. The CSA makes extensive use of these vessels to protect their interests.

Max speed: 2; Shield points: 10000; Hit points: 24000

Maintenance: This starship costs 200 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Venator-class Light Star Destroyer. The Venator-class was the capital ship of choice for the Galactic Republic due to its fighter carrying capacity. While it is a relatively weak warship, the Venator can be highly effective when used in combination with its powerful and sizable fighter garrison. All Star Destroyers have long range but slow firing weapons.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 17000; 2 V-Wing (6), 2 ARC-170 (6), 1 LAAT (1)

A modified Providence Destroyer of one of the last the Separatist Holdouts. When all others joined the Rebel Alliance, Captain Khemry remained loyal to the ideals of the CIS and his personal hero General Grievous. With secret backing from the Banking Clans, Khemry has harassed Imperial operations around the systems of Muunilinst and Mygeeto and policed the sector of Rebel activity for being Republic dogs. Quickly these practices turned into outright piracy and raids turned to civilian vessels and the Banking Clans were paying for protection or ransoms. Khemry and his holdout faction became known as the wealthiest pirate gangs in the galaxy known as the Bone Giants for the many large Kaleesh warriors and their face bones.

Providence "Dreadnought" variant with improved Calamari shields and Heavy Concussion Missile Launchers instead of Proton Torpedo Launchers.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 25000; Hit points: 20000; 2 Vulture (10); 1 HMP (5)

A Dauntless-class Cruiser that led a group of Sullustians in their revolt again the Empire. When Sullust was freed, X was a vocal supporter of total independence and balked at the idea of the restored government to join the Rebel Alliance and their dreams of a reformed the failed Galactic Republic. Seeing no hope in his people X and his followers set out for self-freedom as pirates. X and his crew quickly rose to prominence for raids against Imperial, Rebel, and Civilian traffic in the sector and his powerful ship's dominance over any force rival pirates could muster.

Dauntless Cruiser modified with half of it's Turbolasers replaced for Quad Ion Cannon to disable ships rather than destroy them.

A Kandosii Battleship under the command of a former Death Watch who claims to be the descendant of some great gladiator from the crusades. Kas along with a group of his allies held out when they the Death Watch defeated by Mandalore Spar and his Mandalorian Protectors. He took the last of the Death Watch, an ancient warship in disrepair even though the Beskar hull remained untouched by time, and waged a personal war against Spar's CIS supporters and the Republic invaders before being forced to piracy to survive the Imperial Age and fled Mandalore. When Mandal Hypernautics were under constant raids from the Zann Consortium they pair a handsome bounty and upgraded their vessel with new Mandalorian tech. The infamous Alor'ad and his gang had gathered many likeminded Mando'ade and soon fought off the Consortium piracy efforts only to take their place and use the Mandalore System and their gathered fleet to rule piracy in the sector.

Kandosii Battleship with premium Beskar Armor, Heavy Mass Drivers replacing the missile launchers, and a Point Defense Laser system.

A modified MC75 under the command of and named after the Infamous Blackfish. The rebellious brother of a local administrator of one of Dac's moon who died of sickness during the Clone Wars, his younger niece driven mad, and oldest niece murdered at her brother's wedding by Quarren's who stole her father's position. Pryden and his gang seized his brother's administration building and refused to ever leave again so he was the first to come up with the plan to attach engines to a building and flying it into space that Raddus would later emulate. He armed his new vessel and harassed the CIS in the sector during the war and with the rise of the Galactic Empire turned his sights to true piracy, becoming one of the most renown pirates in the galaxy for his tactical prowess and savagery.

MC-75 Star Cruiser modified with devastating broadsides of 12 Mass Driver Cannons.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 30000; Hit points: 20000; 2 Uglies (2)

Required Planets: MonCalamari

The Lusankya was captured by the New Republic, a sister ship to the Executor. The New Republic refitted her with better armor than Star Dreadnoughts still in Imperial service, several other systems were also redesigned.

During the Yuuzhan Vong War she participated in the Battle of Borleias, where she helped protect the Republic stronghold on Borleias over the course of a month. After taking heavy damage due to attrition, it was decided that she would be abandoned. When the time came to finally evacuate Borleias, the Lusankya was sent to collide into the Domain Hul worldship.

While capable of long range bombardment, she is most effective at close range and engaging multiple targets at once. Vulnerable to bombers.

Max speed: 6; Shield points: 400000; Hit points: 600000; 6 A-Wing (94), 6 Y-Wing (54), 2 A/SF-01-Elite (18)

Maintenance: This starship costs 9250 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets: Byss, Kuat, Fondor, MonCalamari
Special Structures: R_Shipyard_3

Small Target, Weak, Dogfighter

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, or simply Vulture Droid, is a small unmanned fighter that relies on numbers to overwhelm the enemy. While the droid was only lightly armored and armed, it was fairly fast and maneuverable, and helped by its small target profile the Vulture is hard to hit making it surprisingly durable while dogfighting. Produced en mass, these cheap droids were deployed in the thousands at a time by the CIS during the Clone Wars. Best used to swarm lightly armored starfighters, and buy time for more capable fighters to arrive.

Armor: Light 2x Light Laser Agility: 1.875 Max Speed: 3.5 HP: 21 15 Models per squadron.

Light laser: rapid-fire, short-ranged, weak vs armor 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 0.5s reload, 150m range. Discord missile: mid-ranged, small AOE, no shield penetration. 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 375m range. Applies -33% HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship in a small area for 30s.

Required Planets: Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost

The Vulture HCP, or Haor Chall Prototype, is a field test model for mass production of variable loadouts on droid starfighters. Despite this, results are typical of the Vulture Droid line aside from an improved alpha strike capability. Vulture HCPs remain fast, weakly armored and small enough that organic pilots find them hard to hit. Best used to overwhelm high priority starfighter targets.

Small Target, Dogfighter, Glass Cannon, Powerful Engines

Designed by Colicoid Creation Nest, who also designed the Droideka, the Tri-Fighter is a high-performance space superiority droid. While lightly armored, the Tri-Fighter is fast, agile and presents a small target profile making it deadly in a dogfight. Equipped with Discord missiles that deliver Buzz Droids to the target, the Tri-Fighter is able to lower the max HP of fighters, bombers and gunships, allowing it to pick apart its prey. Best used in a dogfight in support of lighter craft (such as Vulture Droids) that cannot by themselves take on high HP targets.

Armor: Light 1x Medium Laser, 3x Discord Missile Agility: 2.1 Max Speed: 4.25 HP: 21 8 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. Discord missile: mid-ranged, small AOE, no shield penetration. 5 ||| 5 | 4 | 2 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 375m range. Applies -33% HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship in a small area for 30s.

The Hyena-class Bomber, or simply Hyena Droid, is an unmanned bomber that relies on numbers to overwhelm the enemy. It’s maneuverable and fast for a bomber, while still packing a solid payload for its size. Produced en mass, these cheap droids were deployed in the thousands at a time by the CIS during the Clone Wars. Best used to overwhelm AA fire and destroy larger vessels.

Lucrehulk-class Droid-Control Ship. Originally cargo haulers, the Lucrehulks of the Trade Federation were pushed into military service during the Clone Wars, proving useful as massive transports capable of carrying thousands of droids. As warships, they were effective against the Republics carrier-oriented Venators. With the advent of the Empire and its doctrine of heavy, ship-to-ship combat oriented warships, the Lucrehulk has lost much of its former potency. It is still however, a well-shielded and armored supercarrier.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 55000; Hit points: 55200; 6 Vulture Fighter (16), 4 Hyena Bomber (12), 2 TriFighter Interceptor (4)

Maintenance: This starship costs 3600 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets (Neutral, Rebel, Underworld): Mustafar, Muunilinst, Cato_Neimoidia, Nimban, Pammant, Neimoidia, Foerost, MonCalamari
Special Structures (Rebel): R_Shipyard_3
Special Structures (Underworld): U_Shipyard_3

Lucrehulk-class Battleship. Towards the end of the Clone Wars some Droid-Control Ships were modified further into battlecruisers. While no longer considered supercarriers, these warships could outgun any republic vessel and can still stand up to most heavy Star Destroyers today. Armed with significantly more weapons than the Control Ship, but carries fewer fighters.

Max speed: 2.5; Shield points: 55000; Hit points: 117600; 3 Vulture Fighter (8), 2 Hyena Bomber (6), 1 TriFighter Interceptor (2)

Maintenance: This starship costs 2200 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Large Unit, Expert Dogfighter, Fires Sideways, Adv. Armor & Materials

The StarViper Attack Platform is the mass-producable devolution of Prince Xizor's personal starfighter Virago. While the Virago was meant to be the only craft of its kind, Mandalmotors reaquired the production rights and designed a mass-produceable version: the SVAP-2. Although the standard Starviper is less powerful, it is still an astonishingly powerful and advanced starfighter design, with the pricetag to boot.

Extremely maneuverable thanks to its heavily armored maneuvering fins and highly durable due to its strong High-Capacity shields, the Starviper also comes with an advanced targetting system for its swiveling weapon mounts, allowing the craft to fire sideways and even backwards. While durable, the large Starviper presents a massive up-front target profile, making it an easy target for even inaccurate weaponry with its S-foils unlocked. It is especially vulnerable to anti-large weaponry in a head-on strike, where it relies on its flares or even its S-foils to counteract hostile torpedoes. Dispite this vulnerability, the Starviper attack platform is a top of the line assault fighter that can be used against a variety of targets and excels at dogfighting. Also excellent in the presence of SF repair drones.

Armor: Heavy 6x (in 4) Medium Laser Turret, 1x Advanced Homing Torpedo Agility: 2.475 Max Speed: 3.5 SP: 55(3/s) HP: 62 5 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. Adv Homing torpedo: tracks target, ignores shields, great vs armor. 26 | 25 | 24 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 475m range. Applies -33% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

Kyramud-class Battleship is a capital ship dating back to the Mandalorian Wars where it served as the mainstay of the Neo-Crusader fleet. A heavily armored insectoid vessel that while quite large features limited armament for its size and relying on it's bulk, beskar armor shell, and compliment of Basilisk Wardroids to protect it while it unleashes long ranged missile barrages from it's 10 missile launchers.

Ignores Nebulae, Small Target, Dogfighter, Solar Sails, Interceptor Shielding, Powerful Engines

This unit ignores the effect of nebulae on its shields.

The expensive Miy'Tok Starfighter comes fully equipped with an advanced power management system and two solar sails, generating additional power for its engines, shield generator and weapon systems, providing a boost to the Miy'Tok's combat performance. More capable than the small and nimble Miy'Tok interceptor, the larger Miy'Tok is a capable fighter craft, its only real weakness being its large target profile due to its sail, and lack of heavy weaponry to combat heavily armored foes. Best used to dogfight lightly armored craft.

Armor: Light 2x Light Laser, 2x Medium Laser Agility: 2.1 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 22(4.5/s) HP: 30 6 Models per squadron.

Large Unit, Anti-Large, Ion Torpedo, Armor-Piercing, Astromech, High Capacity Shielding, Powerful Engines

The large Miy'Til Bomber is a fast and durable heavy strike bomber deployed on rare occasions by the Hapes Consortium. With an emphasis on speed and durability it can outrun most fighter craft, especially when diverting additional power to its already powerful engines. It can execute fast hit & run strikes, heavily debuffing the shields and armor of an enemy starship upon hit to support friendly starships, or stay around for longer and deal serious damage to both shields and armor with its dual ion and advanced torpedo launchers. Best used to attack and debuff large enemy starships, bringing down the shields and armor of hostile craft to more manageable levels for the rest of the Hapan Starfleet to take on.

Armor: Heavy 2x Medium Laser, 2x Adv. Proton Torpedo, 2x Ion Torpedo Agility: 1.725 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 55(3/s) HP: 70 5 Models per squadron.

Adv Proton torpedo: ignores shields, great vs armor. 26 | 25 | 24 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 475m range. Applies -33% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s Ion torpedo: crippling debuff, great vs shields, no hull DMG. 500 DMG vs starship shields, 15s reload, 375m range. Applies -33% Max SP, firepower, speed debuff to Corv/Frig/Cap/Structure for 14s

Land Bombing Run Unit Bombing Run Ordnance: Ion Charged Bombs, effective against shielded targets. Stuns vehicles. Bombing Run Type: Carpet Bombing

Reserve max: 1x MiyTok_Garrison, 1x Miytil_Bomber_Garrison

Hapan Battle Dragon. The main ship of the line for the Hapan Royal Navy, the Battle Dragon is as elegant as it is efficient. It can maintain a surprising volume of firepower towards any one target by synchronizing its weapon reload speed with the rotation of the two dishes they are mounted on. Dispite its small size, this allows the Dragon to spew a hail of turbolaser and ion cannon fire at its target. While this makes the Battle Dragon an amazingly effective ship against single targets, it cannot focuss its supremely optimized fire sequence at more than one target at a time.

This unit ignores the effect of nebulae on its shields.

Max speed: 3.0; Shieldpoints: 8000; Hitpoints: 8000; 1 Miy'Til Bomber (1), 1 Miy'Tok Fighter (1)

Maintenance: This starship costs 120 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Armor-Piercing, Dogfighter, Interceptor Shielding, Advanced Engines

An ancient starfighter that has survived four millennia in use in countless fleets across the galaxy. Famed for its light, nimble frame, moderate shielding and heavy armament. The already impressive speed of the craft is even more improved at the cost of weapon power with s-foils. All these features have given the Aurek-class Tactical Stikefighter a long and impressive history. The One-Two punch of the Proton Torpedo shaving off the hull of a target starfighter and Medium Lasers packing a strong punch makes the Aurek have a strong alpha strike while it’s speed and fast recharging Interceptor Shields allows it to evade reprisal from slower or slow firing enemies. This however means the Aurek is vulnerable to fast interceptors with rapid fire lasers or missile weapons that can punch through the shields to the weak hull.

Armor: Medium 2x Swiveling Medium Laser, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 2.55 Max Speed: 4.0 SP: 20(4.5/s) HP: 30 6 Models per squadron.

Medium laser: mid-ranged, good vs armor. 12 ||| 12 |10 | 8 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 2.0s reload, 250m range. Proton torpedo: ignores shields, good vs armor, inaccurate. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

Harrower-class Dreadnought. An ancient warship of the Resurgent Sith Empire. Famed for the siege of the capitol of the Galactic Republic on the orders of the mad Sith Emperor and his followers making the sith great again. The Harrower is covered in turbolasers across it’s massive hull, making it a true Dreadnought of its age. This however makes it vulnerable to highly shielded vessels and starfighters. Harrower makes up for its lack of anti-starfighter weapons with enough holes in its body to become a fry cook at the Krusty Krab. Each opening is a hangar filled with ancient Sith Fighters.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 25000; Hit points: 60000; 12 Sith Fighter (24)

The V-19 Torrent is a true relic of the Clone Wars, increasingly phased out of service by 20 BBY in favor of V-wings and the Arc-170. This was due to its large size, lack of shields and only middling armament. However, it’s still a plucky, nimble fighter that can stall Peer-Adversaries until modern interceptor backup arrives.

Anti-Large, Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Astromech

The Incom built Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 was designed for the Republic in the late stages of the Clone Wars and is the predecessor to the X-Wing, also designed by Incom. While ineffective against the CIS' swarms of small droids, the Arc-170 is heavily armed and capable of piercing starship armor, making it an excellent fire-support Starfighter. It is also equipped with an astromech for onboard repairs and two rear turrets, making it a capable dogfighter, and up close its otherwise inaccurate Heavy Lasers can deal heavy damage to large targets such as gunships. Excellent when combined with V-wings to screen smaller craft that the Arc-170 itself has difficulty hitting reliably. Best used to attack large targets such as gunships or for supporting bombers against (unshielded) starships.

Armor: Medium 2x Heavy Laser, 1x Rear Light Laser Turret, 1x Proton Torpedo Agility: 1.65 Max Speed: 3.0 SP: 35(3/s) HP: 38(1/s) 6 Models per squadron.

Heavy laser: long-ranged, great vs armor. 24 ||| 24 | 23 | 21 DMG vs S ||| L | M | H armor, 3.0s reload, 450m range. Proton torpedo: ignores shields, good vs armor, inaccurate. 20 | 18 | 16 DMG vs L | M | H armor, 15s reload, 425m range. Applies -25% Max HP debuff to Fighter/Bomber/Gunship/Corvette for 14s

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Armor-Piercing, Shoddy Construction

This light torpedo bomber modification to the Z-95 sees the warhead launcher fire Proton Torpedoes instead of Concussion Missiles. This makes the Headhunter, this version nicknamed the Hullcracker, a relatively cost-effective light support craft against corvettes and frigates. However, the Hullcracker remains a Headhunter at heart, designed to be cheap and mass-produceable and in low numbers struggle to deal significant damage.

Large Unit, Dogfighter, Glass Cannon, Burstfire

Designed for in-atmosphere airstrikes, the Heavy Missile Platform Droid is a relatively small but very well-armed gunboat. In space the HMP is a very capable fire-support craft, capable of shooting down most starfighters thanks to its impressive missile barrage, however it is vulnerable to countermeassures. For self-defense, the HMP is equipped with two forward-fixed Medium Lasers, two dual Light Laser turrets and a single Medium laser turret offering excellent coverage around the gunship. While the HMP is impressively armed and relatively well-shielded for its small size, it lacks hull strength and is best used as a fire-support unit as opposed to a stand-alone craft. Excellent when combined with light fighters such as Vulture or Tri-Fighter droids.

The Jackal Droid is an advanced multirole starfighter in the service of the Confederate Navy. The latest in the famous droid starfighter line from Baktoid Armor Workshop, the flexible starfighter is armed with a variable loadout consisting of both discord missiles and a powerful Ion Torpedo depending on its target. The Jackal excels at taking out enemy starfighters and shredding shields on larger ships, but will struggle against dedicated interceptors and finishing off unshielded vessels.

The Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor, also known as the Jedi Interceptor, was a Republic air superiority fighter produced by Kuat Systems Engineering shortly before the Clone Wars. It was primarily designed for use by the Jedi Order, necessitating a craft that was hyper maneuverable and with explosive acceleration potential. The modern iterations of the Delta-7 possess a modest armament and an internal hyperspace drive, eschewing the need for the bulky Hyperspace ring of the past. Best used to dogfight lightly armored foes and to stall heavy armored craft until backup arrives.

Those that fight for the Alliance, fight for freedom, and the promise of a life without tyranny. They fight harder, gaining +20% durability. Anti-Large, Dogfighter, Armor-Piercing, Astromech

The Incom built Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 was designed for the Republic in the late stages of the Clone Wars and is the predecessor to the X-Wing, also designed by Incom. While ineffective against the CIS' swarms of small droids, the Arc-170 is heavily armed and capable of piercing starship armor, making it an excellent fire-support Starfighter. It is also equipped with an astromech for onboard repairs and two rear turrets, making it a capable dogfighter, and up close its otherwise inaccurate Heavy Lasers can deal heavy damage to large targets such as gunships. Excellent when combined with V-wings to screen smaller craft that the Arc-170 itself has difficulty hitting reliably. Best used to attack large targets such as gunships or for supporting bombers against (unshielded) starships.

Dogfighter, Heavy, Sturdy, Indigenous

The hardy Utapauan Porax-38 features strong High-Capacity shields and thick armor, but also achieved notoriety for its modular design. While durable, the Porax presents a sizable target profile while turning and suffers from poor handling in a dive. This makes it especially vulnerable to anti-large weaponry while dogfighting, where it relies on its flares to counteract missile ordnance. Despite these shortcomings, its survivability and customization options made it a favored craft among bounty hunters or forward-deployed escorts long after the Clone Wars.

Very Large Unit, Anti-Large, Armor-Piercing, Repair Drones, Support, Adv. Materials, Repair Crew, High Capacity Shielding, Slow

Built intentionally as a slow flying fortresses in the days of the Republic to prevent usage by pirates, the heavily armored Gozanti is an extremely durable gunship and transport equipped with repair drones it can use to facilitate repairs to itself or nearby craft. Armed with heavy laser turrets and a forward-mounted torpedo launcher it is easily capable of defending itself against large units and hostile gunships, but its appalling agility and top speed make it an easy target for heavy weaponry. Nevertheless it performs its intended duty admirably as the Gozanti has seen many decades of service and continues to stay relevant in the age of the Empire. Best used to tank endless volleys of small-arms fire and support surrounding craft with its repair drones.

The Consular-class Cruiser (otherwise known as the Republic Frigate) is a diplomatic vessel turned warship from the early days of the Clone Wars. The Charger C70 Refit saw the vessel armed with five Heavy Dual Laser Cannons alongside a Dual Ion Cannon, making these ships excellent escort vessels for anti-starfighter duty or stunning enemy vessels. Its powerful engines allow it to quickly chase down fleeing vessels or escape danger.

The Warlord-class is a patrol Corvette equipped with strong hull armor to cover its underwhelming shields. The vessel's forward firepower is impressive for its size, but limited fire-arcs on its lasers make the Warlord vulnerable when engaged from the rear. Ease of manufacture made the Warlord a popular, if basic, starfighter screening platform due to the appreciated presence of its point-defense laser cannons.

A Sullustan warship that predates the Clone Wars, the Hornet-class is a dedicated starfighter carrier and command vessel serving in pirate and corporate fleets. While its armament and survivability aren’t very competitive against modern ships, it remains a practical way to rapidly deploy large numbers of manned bombers against light resistance. Best used to finish off wounded ships or from the back of a fleet.

Victory I-class Star Destroyer. Designed during the Clone Wars, the Victory I was the Republic Navy’s first iteration of a larger ship-to-ship combat vessel to support the Venator-class. This greater offensive capability is primarily derived from its large number of concussion missile tubes, capable of devastating alpha strikes on enemy shield generators. However, its engines are slow and inefficient, leaving the Victory-class vulnerable to falling out of position and struggling to keep pace with faster fleets.

Servator-class Star Destroyer. The Servator-class is a refit of the Venator born from the harsh necessity of the battlefield. Republic loyalist-controlled shipyards in the early years after the coup were underequipped, lacking basic resources and their previously wide engineering talent pool. However, the few that remained led a creative effort to utilize aging hulls for sorely needed frontline battleships. The result was only partially successful. The Servator features strong firepower, at the expense of its hangar size and limited shield improvements.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 18000; Hit points: 24700

Maintenance: This starship costs 150 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Grey Wind is an Imperial-1-class Star Destroyer under the command of Admiral Thrawn.

Fleet commander: (UPGRADED) Desperate times have made their impression on Thrawn, and experience has taught him to more efficiently use capitals. Under his command, corvettes and frigates perform majestically, gaining +20% Shield Strength, +20% Damage and +30% Movement Speed. However, Thrawn does not see the point in using battlecruisers and dreadnaughts. To him, they are a waste of resources, and he prefers to not use them at all, debuffing them in battle by -10% Shield Strength, -10% Damage and -20% Movement Speed, making him distinctly different from your regular Imperial Fleet Commander.

Always stacks with other fleet commander bonuses.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 15000; Hit points: 42000; 1 TIE/IN (2), 1 TIE/ad (1), 1 TIE/sa (1)

Upgradable Hero - Must be present to upgrade Required Planet: Kuat Required Tech: 4 Required Colony Lvl: 3 Required Shipyard: Major Construction Yard Required Station: Command Relay Network

Mon Calamari- Home One-class. The Home One subclass are aged Deep Space Exploration Cruisers converted into a Battleships for the Mon Calamari fleet. These ships feature the stronger armor plating and shields than their smaller MC80 cousins while being armed with much more powerful weapons to rival Imperial Star Destroyers while carrying a large compliment of starfighters. These ships are the best all-round warships of the Mon Calamari but are still highly vulnerable to equal sized Star Battlecruisers.

Max speed: 3; Shield points: 70000; Hit points: 64000; 1 X-Wing (3), 1 A-Wing (3), 1 Y-Wing (3), 1 A-Wing (3), 1 X4 Gunship (2)

Maintenance: This starship costs 2250 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Special Structures: R_Shipyard_3

Functioning as Admiral Tallon’s Command ship, the Battalion is a Praetor-class battlecruiser known for its service against Separatists Holdouts. Adar Tallon is a successful admiral from the Clone Wars and notably disconcerted by the direction of the New Order, though his loyalty remains strong as long as there are Separatists to fight. What will happen afterward is anyone’s guess…

Max Speed: 3.5; Shieldpoints: 100000; Hitpoints: 450000; 2 TIE Fighter (6), 2 TIE Bomber (6), 1 Lambda Combat Shuttle (1)

Fighter 50.0·Bomber 50.0·Gunship 45.0·Transport 30.0·Corvette 14.0·Frigate 10.0·Capital 10.0·SpaceStructure 10.0·Super 10.0

A relic of Galactic Republic's naval limitations, the Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser is a powerful defensive platform boasting impressive layered armor and powerful shield generators for even by modern standards. While not as conventionally powerful as modern vessels of it's size, the Praetor is more than capable of holding the line.

Max Speed: 3.5; Shieldpoints: 100000; Hitpoints: 450000; 2 V-Wing (6), 2 ARC-170 (6), 1 Gozanti (1)

Maintenance: This starship costs 4125 credits per month for maintenance and upkeep. Units with a significant starfighter garrison cost less upkeep as their starfighters pay attrition costs over time.

Required Planets: Ringo_Vinda, Rendili, Rothana, Allanteen
